results.title: Seacoast Service Partners Acquires Von Aire Air Conditioning & Heating | White Wolf Capital Group
results.summary: Seacoast Service Partners (SSP), a White Wolf Capital Group-backed platform focused on plumbing, HVAC, and refrigeration in the Southeast, has acquired Von Aire Air Conditioning & Heating, Inc. (Von Aire), a long-standing, family-owned HVAC contractor based in Holly Hill, Florida. This 15th acquisition expands SSP’s footprint across Central and Northeast Florida, strengthening its service presence in Volusia, Flagler, southern St. Johns, Lake, and Seminole counties. Von Aire, founded in 1968, is known for technical expertise, dependable workmanship, and community involvement, with a loyal customer base and tenured staff. The deal aligns with SSP’s buy-and-build strategy of partnering with profitable, service-oriented businesses to enhance geographic reach and service capabilities. White Wolf Capital Group’s Seacoast criteria target add-ons with revenues up to $25 million in the Southeastern US, strong customer relations, and potential for geographic or service expansion.

results.title: TruTemp Services Expands North Carolina Footprint with Two Complementary Acquisitions
results.summary: TruTemp Services, a Centre Partners and Baldwin Creek Partners-backed residential HVAC, plumbing, and electrical services platform, announced two NC acquisitions to expand its Southeast footprint: D&D HVAC (Sanford) and Sandhills Heating & Refrigeration (Aberdeen). These add-ons, following the 2025 Maynor acquisition, create a connected North Carolina footprint from Raleigh/Apex/Durham to Sanford and Aberdeen, increasing recurring revenue through a denser service area and broader capabilities. D&D provides HVAC installation/maintenance/repair; Sandhills offers HVAC and electrical installation, replacement, maintenance, and repair. Local leaders Dairus Davis (D&D) and Bradford Hainley (Sandhills) will continue to run operations. The move aligns with TruTemp’s strategy to scale via organic growth and acquisitions and to accelerate investments in people, systems, and service offerings.

results.title: Founders Home Service Group Expands Middle Tennessee Footprint with Acquisition of The Air Guys LLC
results.summary: Founders Home Service Group, backed by Kompass Kapital, announced the acquisition of The Air Guys LLC, a family-owned HVAC, electrical, and plumbing contractor based in Chapel Hill, TN. The deal, facilitated by Viking Mergers & Acquisitions, extends Founders’ Middle Tennessee footprint and Southeast presence by integrating The Air Guys’ established brand, loyal local customer base, and “people-first” culture. The transaction underscores ongoing private-equity–backed platform appetite for add-on acquisitions of regional home services businesses. Founders will preserve The Air Guys’ local leadership and branding while providing strategic capital and operational support to fuel growth. Advisors: Viking Mergers & Acquisitions (Kyle Kerrigan, Ben Locke).

results.title: North Haven Capital (via Public) / Northeast Elements, Inc. Enters Strategic Expansion Phase Via Add-On Acquisition of Maine-based Donnell Plumbing & Heating Company
results.summary: North Haven Capital-backed Northeast Elements, Inc. (NEI) announces the add-on acquisition of Donnell Plumbing & Heating, a Maine-based, family-owned contractor with 37 years of residential HVAC, plumbing, and maintenance experience. The deal expands NEI’s geographic footprint from New England into central/southern Maine and New Hampshire, enabling a broader “Home Wellness Services” platform with end-to-end residential systems (HVAC, geothermal, plumbing, water treatment). Financing for the transaction came from North Haven Capital’s Limited Partners and Mizzen Capital. NEI aims to deepen recurring revenue through Donnell’s repair-focused service model and accelerate growth across its expanded service corridor.

results.title: Southern Home Services Expands Mid-Atlantic Presence with Acquisition of Blazer Heating, Air & Plumbing in Richmond
results.summary:
Summary:
- Southern Home Services (a PE-backed, multi-brand home services platform) announces the acquisition of Blazer Heating, Air & Plumbing, a 37-year-old family-owned HVAC and plumbing provider in Richmond, Virginia.
- The move expands Southern Home Services’ Mid-Atlantic footprint and strengthens its presence in Mechanicsville, Glen Allen, Chesterfield, Henrico, Hanover and surrounding Richmond markets.
- Blazer will continue to operate under its local leadership (General Manager Bobby Broyles) with added resources and support from Southern, preserving the local brand and culture.
- Financial terms were not disclosed; legal and advisory teams named include Nelson Mullins (Southern), Williams Mullen (Blazer), and Marriott & Co. (Blazer’s financial advisor).
- This acquisition aligns with Southern’s strategy of consolidating trusted local brands under a centralized platform to deliver enhanced service and operational scale.
